about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a world where monsters have special attributes and characteristics, and your decisions determine the outcome of events.

You are an analyst imprisoned in the Bureau, your job is to identify and solve cases involving monsters.

You have only documents provided by victims and simple systems of analysis, assumptions and checks established by the Bureau. With this limited arsenal, you must decide who is to blame and what actions to take.

Game Features:

  • Deep interaction mechanics: Explore monster abilities and their attributes to conduct a successful hunt.

  • Dynamic events: Time and activity play a key role - keep an eye on the schedule of events and the time of monster activity to prevent tragedies.

  • Strategic Choices: Make decisions that will affect the development of the plot and relationships with people and monsters.

  • Mysterious World: Solve the mysteries of this unusual world.

What awaits you:

  • Research monsters with unique characteristics.

  • Participate in events that happen in the world.

  • Open new opportunities and improve your workplace.

And remember! Many incidents go unnoticed, some become known, but no one suspects that there are those that were caused by paranormal entities. Will you be able to distinguish one from the other?

short_description: Story-driven, first-person, fantasy detective simulator set in the early 20th century. Investigate citizens' strange requests, uncover paranormal phenomena, and research new monsters to upgrade your workplace.
